criteria.criterion: [operator-attested] rebar reconciles bidirectionally against the Dockerized Jira SDK instance at localhost:2990 — at least one issue created in DC appears in the local store after an inbound pass, and one local edit appears on the DC issue after an outbound pass, with zero unhandled exceptions

No SHARED mapping logic exists in two places, and each VARYING unit has exactly one shared CONTRACT (amended: cross-imports machine-checked, one dict literal per value map, boundary checker has teeth)
